verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, b'at man junok tzek'ul nab'a lino, tzak'anoch t'a a nanhal ayik manto juk'chajok, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in manan jun tzek'ul chi' icha ix yal Jehová, ix wak'anoch t'a in nanhal.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin:
Ik'b'at jun a tzek'ul ix a man chi', jun ayoch t'a a nanhal chi', tzach b'at t'a Perat. Hata' tza k'ub'ejel t'a sjatelal junok k'een tenam, xchi Jehová.
Ix in b'at b'ian, ix in k'ub'anel jun tzek'ul chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin.
Ix ek' junok tiempoal, ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ixik t'a Perat, b'at ik'xikot jun tzek'ul in cheknak b'at a k'ub'ejel ta', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in b'at b'ian, ix in joyan b'aj aykan chi' wuuj, ix wik'ankoti, palta k'axo, manhxalaj yopisio.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin yik swaleli:
Icha tik ol aj in satanel yik'ojchanhb'ail Judá yet' Jerusalén.

Ha ex in chonhab' ex tik, te chuk ex, malaj he gana tze k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, anhej tas tze nib'ej a tze k'ulej. Tzex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, tzeyak'an serwil. Lajan ex icha jun tzek'ul manhxalaj yopisio tik.

Icha junok mach stzek'och junok tzek'ul t'a snanhal, icha chi' ix in k'ulej eyet' ex aj Israel yet' ex aj Judá, yik junnhej tzex aj wet'ok, in chonhab' eyaji, yik tzeyak'an ojtakajeli to b'inajnak in, niwan welk'ochi. Palta maj in he k'anab'ajej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a heb' etchonhab' tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alani: Junjun yet'tal wino, smoj sb'ut'ji yuj wino, xa chi. Ol yalan heb' t'ayach: Toxon kojtak to junjun yet'tal wino smoj sb'ut'ji yuj, xcham heb'.

Ol halan t'a heb' to a in swal icha tik: Ol wak' sat he k'ol he masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun chonhab' tik yuj yowal in k'ool, icha wal tz'aj sat sk'ol mach niwan wino syuk'ej. Ha heb' ol satel sk'ol chi', haton heb' rey yinhtilal winhaj David, heb' sakerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' masanil ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik.

Ol wak' he mak'lajcham he b'a icha tz'aj spojb'at lum yet'tal wino ayik stenlan sb'a lu'um. Lajan ol yutej sb'a heb' mamab'il yet' heb' uninab'il. Ha in wal Jehová in swala', ol ex in sateli, manhxo ol ok'laj in k'ol t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ex aj Judá, a Jehová wan slolon t'ayex. Emnakil tzeyutej he b'a, tze maklan eyab' tas syala'.

Alekk'eta he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yakb'an manta tas skot t'a eyib'anh, icha sk'ulej heb' sb'eyek' t'a sat pak'an t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Tze na' to ol ja wach'ilal t'ayex palta te niwan yaelal ol kot t'a eyib'anh yuj Jehová, ichato ol k'ik'b'ok k 'inal ol heyila'.
Tato max he cha eyab'i, elk'altak ol in ok' yuj eyik'ojchanhb'ail chi'. Ol elta yal in sat, yujto ol ex ik'chajkanb'at t'a najat, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin: Al t'a winh a reyal yet' t'a ix snun winh: Emanhekkot t'a xilail he reyal, tzex em k'ojan t'a sat lu'um, yujto ol ik'chajel he korona manh jantakok swach'il yilji ayk'e t'a he jolom.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a Neguev ol makchaj yuj heb' soldado, ol oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak, manhxa mach ol yal yochi. Masanil heb' aj Judá, ol ik'chajkanb'at heb' t'a najat.
Ixikek k'elan t'a stojolal norte, tzeyilan skot heb' ajk'ool. ¿Tas yaj in chonhab' wak'nakoch t'a yol he k'ab' he tanhwani, haton heb' ayoch he b'inajb'ilok?
¿Tas ol eyala' ayik ol wak'anoch juntzanh anima eyajalilok, haton heb' eyak'nakoch yipok he k'ool? Ol ja yaelal t'a eyib'anh icha sjawi yaelal t'a yib'anh junok ix ix wan yalji yune'.
Ex aj Jerusalén, tato tze k'anb'ej tas yuj sjawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, nachajokab' el eyuuj to yuj jantak he mul, yuj chi' b'eran ex eli tzex eq'ui, tzex te ixtajpaxi.
Ha junok k'ik'al anima, tokwal syal sk'exmaj yilji. Ha spintotakil nok' leopardo, tokwal syal sk'exmaji. Ichexta' te k'aynak ex t'a chukal, maxtzak yal sk'exmaj he b'eyb'al.
Yuj chi' ol ex in saklemejb'ati, icha tz'aj saklemkanb'at smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik' skot t'a takinh lu'um.
Haton wal tik aykanoch t'a eyib'anh wuuj, icha wal smojal. Yujto ix in b'atkan satk'olal eyuuj, haxonhej juntzanh komon Dios tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool.
Ol ex wak'el b'eran, ol ex wak'an q'uixwelal.

Ix wil jantak eyajmulal, haton juntzanh q'uixwelaltak tze k'ulej. Yajb'entak tas tze k'ulej t'a lum jolomtak witz yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil. Ex aj Jerusalén, ob'iltak ex, ¿b'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan he k'ulan chukal chi'? xchi Jehová.
